page.overview:
Who is Wy-Yes?

Wy-Yes, full name Wyatt B. Yessler, is a character appearing in , who was a member of the Rising Volt Tacklers.

Wy-Yes is an adult man with short green hair and dark purple eyes. He normally wears a light teal green shirt with chest pockets, a brown belt with a yellow buckle, a yellow watch, and light grey trousers. As a journalist, he carries equipment such as notepads, a camera, a sunhat, and black bags.

Wy-Yes is a mischievous person who loves to exaggerate and prank others, or mix facts with rumors. Due to his constant lying, he and Mollie have a complicated relationship. However, he also believes that the truth depends on a person, and is ambitious about his own career as a journalist.

Wy-Yes was a member who joined the Rising Volt Tacklers two days before Mollie. At first, Mollie respected him, but she gradually stopped bothering to care about him after she got pranked by his equivocations and pranks more than once. Wy-Yes would later leave the Rising Volt Tacklers sometime before Dot joined, proclaiming that he wanted to become an authentic reporter, and had since been publishing articles and photographing Pokémon that also include Legendary Pokémon as part of his journalistic career.
